# Amazon MemoryDB engine runtime and snapshots

**Status: future extensions.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Valkey and Redis OSS engine containers with ACL enforcement are implemented. Snapshots, parameter groups and multi-node lifecycle remain.

## Proposed scope

- [x] Valkey and Redis OSS engine containers behind cluster and node endpoints
- [x] ACL and user enforcement from access strings
- [ ] Snapshots, restore and final snapshots
- [ ] Parameter group CRUD and values
- [ ] Failover, scaling and engine upgrades with node lifecycle
- [ ] Multi-Region clusters, reserved nodes and service updates
